status: DRAFT FOR OWNER REVIEW. Not run.
source: Zenodo records API: type=dataset, access_right=open, licence cc-zero or cc-by-4.0, at least one .csv file of at most 64000 bytes, with a related identifier pointing to a journal article; article looked up in the Europe PMC open-access subset (licence CC BY).
order: SHA-256 of 'claimcheck-v1.1-prospective-2026|<Zenodo id>', ascending, within each stratum
notes: Query words name subjects and kinds of measurement, never results.
A record returned by queries of two strata is assigned by the article's Europe PMC journal subject; if that does not decide, to the stratum whose query returned it first in the order above.
Stratum A deliberately repeats the v1 context; every record of the v1 pool is excluded by contamination.py.
